title: Enterprise commitments, invoicing & marketplace intake rubric
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create and operationalize a deterministic intake and prioritization rubric for enterprise pricing/packaging and billing requests (commitments, invoicing variations, cost allocation, marketplace flows). Goal: reduce ambiguity in requests, surface finance/legal constraints early, and provide triage outcomes within 5 business days. Scope excludes product bugs and low-touch rate-limit/quotas requests.
background: We receive ad-hoc enterprise asks (custom commitments, special invoicing terms, cost center chargebacks, marketplace reseller billing) that frequently stall because intake lacks standardized fields and engineering/finance validation. This causes long response cycles and inconsistent commitments. PM team needs a repeatable template, decision matrix, and routing rules to accelerate outcomes and reduce accidental legal/finance exposure.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Intake form implemented in Zendesk/Forms with required fields: customer ARR, desired commitment term, invoicing cadence, tax/jurisdiction notes, cost-allocation keys, marketplace partner id. 2) Triage rubric documented and used by PMs with clear thresholds for: immediate approval, requires finance/legal review, engineering work needed. 3) SLA: triage decision (Approve/Decline/Needs Info) within 5 business days for incoming enterprise billing requests. 4) Console ticket generation: approved commitments produce a line-item spec for ENG & FIN with required fields. 5) Dashboard for tracking time-to-decision and outcome by customer.
decision_log: 2026-03-11: Chose Zendesk + a lightweight Google Form for initial rollout to capture attachments. 2026-03-12: Agreed on three-tier rubric: Fast-Approve (standard commitment template), Finance-Review (non-standard terms / >$250k ARR), Legal-Review (contractual invoicing deviations or unusual tax requirements). Marketplace flows route to Partnerships before finance approval. Engineering work scoped separately via ENG-2987.
progress_updates: 2026-03-10: Kickoff with Finance, Legal, Partnerships. 2026-03-11: Draft intake fields and rubric v0 complete. 2026-03-12: Feedback from Finance: require cost center tagging and invoice GL code mapping. 2026-03-12: Draft email templates for 'Needs Info' and 'Approved' routing. 2026-03-12: Created datasource for tracking in Metabase (ENG-2045 to integrate).
open_actions: 1) Build Zendesk intake form and map fields to PM dashboard (owner: Liam, due 2026-03-19). 2) Finance to publish standard GL mappings and required invoice metadata (owner: Priya Shah, due 2026-03-17). 3) Legal to produce checklist for 'invoice term deviations' that trigger contract amendment (owner: Markus Neumann, due 2026-03-20). 4) ENG-2987 to estimate effort for console exports and API routes to create commitment line-items (owner: Eng Lead, due 2026-03-24). 5) Partnerships to define marketplace reseller ID validation flow (owner: Noor Chen, due 2026-03-18).
risks_and_tradeoffs: - Tight SLA may cause increased review churn; mitigated with clear thresholds. - Implementing custom invoicing fields in product early increases surface area for billing code bugs; mitigate by scoping initial support to manual ops-backed invoicing while building automated paths. - Marketplace special invoices require partner legal reviews that can extend timelines; route to Partnerships first to avoid rework.
notes_from_stakeholders: Finance: prefer Zuora native constructs where possible and want GL code on every invoice. Legal: want templated CLAs for invoice term exceptions. Partnerships: marketplace transactions must include partner mapping and revenue share fields. Sales: need predictable turnarounds for close timing; suggested a 'pre-approval' mailbox for high-value deals.
implementation_notes: Phase 1 (manual ops-backed): intake form -> PM triage -> Finance/Legal review -> OPS issues invoice. Phase 2 (automation): add console UI to create commitment objects, webhook to Billing service, auto-generate invoice templates in Zuora/Stripe. Phase 3: integrate marketplace partner flow (partner id validation, revenue share accounting).
next_steps: 1) Finalize intake form and publish. 2) Run 2-week pilot with 3 sales reps and 5 live requests. 3) Collect metrics: time-to-decision, percent routed to Finance/Legal, pilot outcomes. 4) Reassess thresholds and plan engineering work for release billing-2026.04.
